method: Eight Q3 Balanced outputs were placed in an unlabeled deterministic 2x4 grid and inspected without source panels or filenames.
limitations: This is an internal machine-vision inspection, not a human blinded panel.
Trademark text was not legible in the burger-brand reference.
Image-first candidates were not promoted; they remain experimental at the 75% scan threshold.
Source rights were not independently verified, so source-bearing images are excluded from the public git branch.
